verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas is documented as a browser-native engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU that runs in any browser, and it automatically falls back from WebGPU to WebGL based on browser support. That covers both the WebGL-today and WebGPU-credibility parts of the story. Community comments describe it as lightweight and a sensible web target compared with bloated alternatives for WebGPU, but payload is supported only by anecdote. Missing for 10: concrete engine bundle/payload size figures, and independent hands-on corroboration of WebGPU rendering quality and maturity.
